ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: In the image, a square can be seen, with the side length of the square labeled beside it as 4 cm; a triangle is connected to the upper side of the square, and the base of the triangle completely coincides with the upper side of the square, so this upper side becomes an internal shared side and does not belong to the outer perimeter of the combined pentagon. According to the problem, the side length of the square is 4 cm, so the perimeter of the square is 4×4=16 cm. The triangle has the same perimeter as the square, so the perimeter of the triangle is also 16 cm. When the two figures are joined along one complete 4 cm side, the perimeter of the combined figure = perimeter of the square + perimeter of the triangle − 2×shared side length = 16+16−2×4 = 24 cm.

raw_record.question_text: In the diagram, a square with sides of length $4 \mathrm{~cm}$ and a triangle with the same perimeter as the square are joined together to form a pentagon. What is the perimeter of the pentagon?

method.method_draft: Use a union-perimeter adjustment. First read the image: the triangle is attached to the square along the square’s top side, so that top horizontal side is a shared interior edge and is not part of the final pentagon boundary. From the text, each square side is 4 cm, so the square perimeter is 4×4=16 cm. The triangle has the same perimeter as the square, so its perimeter is also 16 cm. Apply the rule for joining two shapes along a full shared side: combined perimeter = perimeter of square + perimeter of triangle − 2×shared side. The shared side is 4 cm, giving 16+16−8=24 cm.

method.method_draft: Sum only the exposed outer sides of the pentagon. First read the image: after the triangle is placed on top of the square, the pentagon’s boundary consists of three exposed sides of the square plus the two slanted sides of the triangle; the horizontal top side of the square is internal/shared. From the text, each square side is 4 cm, so the three exposed square sides total 3×4=12 cm. The square perimeter is 16 cm, so the triangle perimeter is also 16 cm. Since the triangle’s shared base is the square’s top side, it is 4 cm, so the two exposed slanted triangle sides together measure 16−4=12 cm. Add the exposed parts: 12+12=24 cm.

推理：正方形每条边长 4 cm，所以正方形周长是 4×4=16 cm。三角形的周长与正方形相同，也是 16 cm。三角形与正方形共享的底边就是正方形上边，长度为 4 cm，因此三角形两条外露斜边的长度和为 16−4=12 cm。五边形还包括正方形的三条外露边，长度和为 3×4=12 cm。所以五边形周长为 12+12=24 cm。
